newsitem.title: USA: US Midcontinent markets see gasoline diffs tightening.
newsitem.headline: US Midcontinent markets see gasoline diffs tightening.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot markets saw unleaded gasoline differentials tighten late Tuesday, amid talk of drawdowns in the Williams pipeline and a seasonal draw in gasoline inventories, traders said..
Shipping delays on the Hoston-to-Chicago Explorer Pipeline system may have helped drawdown Williams supplies, traders said.
Bids for Group Three unleaded gasoline rose 0.75 cents late Tuesday, to stand 0.75 cents below the screen.
